messages.subject: Office hours today, 12-2. Schedule changes to Wednesday 12-2 when fall quarter begins.
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,
We have virtual office hours today 12-2 via Zoom (link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862). This is the last week of the current schedule. There is no D-RUG meeting next week because the Datalab is hosting a workshop (The topic is introduction to collaborative and reproducible research and R, check the description and registration link here: https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-reproducible-and-collaborative-research-practices-with-r/)

After next week, the new quarter begins, and your cooRdinators have decided that we will move the weekly meeting time to Wednesdays 12-2. We will return to hybrid meetings, with the in-person part meeting in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library).

See you this afternoon!
-Wes
